question: Who among the following as the Governor administered the oath to the CM of Assam, Himanta Biswa Sarma, in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jagadish Mukhi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jagdish Mukhi **is an Indian politician who is the **Governor of Assam.** 
 
• He is a member of the** Bharatiya Janata Party **and the **Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh**.
 
• Prof Jagdish Mukhi is the **20th Governor of Nagalan**d and he assumed his office on 17th September 2021, as additional charge.
 
• Prof Jagdish Mukhi was also **30th Governor of Assam** and he assumed his office on October 2017.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jagdeep Dhankhar** is an Indian politician and lawyer, who is serving as the 14th and current vice president of India replacing Venkaiah Naidu.
 
• Prior, he served as the **Governor of West Bengal.**
 
• **Padmanabha Balakrishna Acharya** is an Indian politician who was the Governor of Manipur, from 27 June 2019 to 23 July 2019 and Governor of Nagaland.
 
• **Ganga Prasad Chaurasia** is an Indian politician who is currently governor of the state of Sikkim and former **governor of Meghalaya. **
 
 
• **​**He was a member of Bihar Legislative Council.
